messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@acme.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New supplier onboarding — invoice format question

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. We are progressing through Acme's vendor setup and have a couple of questions before we push invoices live:

1) Is Redwood expecting invoices to be submitted via the portal only, or do you accept email-based submissions (finance@redwood.com) as a fallback?
2) Our ERP will send a single PDF per invoice that includes multiple PO line items. Do you require a specific CSV or XML attachment with line-level fields, or is the PDF sufficient if it contains PO numbers and line descriptions?

I've attached an example invoice (acme_sample_invoice_202505.pdf) and a short mapping spreadsheet. We want to avoid rework for our AP team.

Two constraints on our side: we need the PO to be visible to the Redwood system so AP can match (your integration needs to store PO metadata), and for tax purposes we need an acknowledgement with an invoice ID back to our system.

Can you confirm recommended approach and any minimum field requirements? If the portal is required, please send an onboarding link and the minimum fields to populate.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Senior AP Manager — Acme Software

Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — invoice format question

Hi Samir — great to meet you yesterday. Short answers up front: portal preferred; email accepted as a fallback but with limitations.

Portal vs Email
- Portal: preferred because it provides structured line-item ingestion, guaranteed acknowledgements (invoice ID, processing timestamp), and better PO matching. It also supports automated retries and idempotency.
- Email fallback: we accept PDFs to finance@redwood.com, but parsing accuracy is lower and it can add manual intervention. If you choose email, include PO numbers in the email body or subject in the format PO:123456 to help match.

Minimum requirements for smooth processing (portal recommended)
- Invoice number (visible on PDF or as form field)
- Invoice date
- One or more PO numbers (if multiple POs, repeat PO field or attach CSV with mapping)
- Line-level amounts/quantities OR a single total when you include PO numbers that match Ledger lines
- Tax/VAT fields for EU transactions (not relevant for your US entity but noting for completeness)

If you must use email we recommend attaching a small XML/CSV with columns: invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, line_description, quantity, unit_price, line_total — that reduces manual review.

Onboarding link and next steps
- Onboarding form: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/form/entry/ACME-5921 (please complete the minimal fields for AP integration)
- We will create a portal account and invite your AP admin after we receive the completed form.
- For acknowledgements: portal sends a webhook (recommended) or you can receive an acknowledgement email containing the assigned invoice ID and processing status.

I'll loop in Vanessa for any exceptions or to discuss SFTP if that is preferable to you.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Vendor Onboarding — Redwood Inference

Vanessa / Jordan — forwarding Acme's sample and their ask (see attachment names below).

Summary: Acme prefers a portal but will use email with a CSV if needed. Key asks from them: PO visibility in our system for matching and an acknowledgement back to their ERP (webhook or email OK). They also prefer minimal friction for their AP team — single PDF per invoice if parsing is reliable.

Questions for Ops/Platform:
- Vanessa: can we support a short-term email -> CSV extraction workflow with a 1-business-day SLA for manual review if parsing fails? If so, what triage queue would that hit?
- Jordan: can you confirm the portal onboarding flow creates a webhook subscription (or can we surface an acknowledgement email) and whether we can add a PO metadata field that is indexed for matching across multiple POs in a single PDF?

Proposed reply to Acme: recommend portal + webhook acknowledgement as best path, offer CSV template for email fallback, and offer 1-week pilot to validate parsing on 20 sample invoices.

Aisha
